name: Raffles The Palm Dubai
positioning: Baroque-style Raffles beach resort with a private beach on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with a large spa and hammams
Families who want a private beach and a Kids Club
Groups wanting a four-bedroom villa with its own pool

facts.text: The hotel is on the West Crescent of Palm Jumeirah in Dubai.
The hotel has ornate Baroque-style architecture.
Rooms feature bespoke Francesco Molon furnishings.
All rooms have private balconies with views, or are steps from the garden, beach or pool.
Raffles Butlers are available around the clock.
Club guests at the Raffles Club Lounge get complimentary breakfast, afternoon tea and aperitifs.
The Grand Palaces Afternoon Tea is served in the Bluthner Hall.
The Cinq Mondes Spa covers 3,000 square meters.
The spa has authentic Moroccan and Turkish hammams, tepidariums, steam rooms, saunas and ice fountains.
The spa offers VIP spa suites for couples.
Guests can enjoy a private beach and multiple swimming pools.
The Kids Club runs an edutainment programme exploring art, nature and culture.

highlights.text: Raffles The Palm Dubai opened in 2021 as the first Raffles beach resort in the Middle East.
The hotel's design includes handcrafted furniture and 6,000 Swarovski crystal chandeliers.
The Royal Villa has a private entrance, four bedrooms, a Rosa Portogallo marble bathroom, a rooftop pool and a dedicated spa.
Piatti by the Beach is a beachfront restaurant serving authentic southern Italian dishes.
Kalian is a rooftop lounge with views of the Dubai skyline and a menu of sharing plates.

considerations.text: The hotel advises that some services and facilities may be momentarily unavailable or operating with reduced availability.
Spa treatments are available for adults over 18.
WhataHotel notes the island location requires transportation to reach mainland Dubai attractions.
